title: Fractured Reality
description: A story focused mod, in which unknown beings will enter your world and break apart reality itself.
body:
This mod is focused on a story about reality itself breaking apart, with you having the objective to fix it.

**_WARNING: THIS MOD CAN GRIEF YOUR WORLD, PLEASE CHECK THE MOD'S SETTINGS IF YOU WANT TO DISABLE THIS._**

### Fractured Reality currently adds:
- 5 new mobs: 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Presenter, Summoner, Faceless, Moonbreaker, Starseer

</details>

- 1 new bossfight with a dedicated dimension
- Custom skybox
- Voicelines for the new mobs
- Lore discs
- Events based on the current day of the world.
- Config options for Preparation Time, Timescale and Griefing
- Multiplayer compatibility
- Custom Advancements
- New potion effect
- JEI integration if you need extra information about certain items
- New equipment: 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Void Steel Armor, Void Steel Sword, Void Jetpack, Grappling Hook and Grappling Point

</details>
